You can only use each effect of "Rahamu, Envoy of the Sacred Tome" once per turn.

cards.name: Red Hypernova Dragon
cards.description:
4 Tuners + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must first be Synchro Summoned with the above materials. Gains 500 ATK for each Tuner in your GY. Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card, also banish as many cards in your opponent's field and GY as possible, then you can Special Summon 1 "Red Nova Dragon" from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon).

cards.name: Red Nova Dragon/Assault Mode
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Assault Mode Activate". When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control until the End Phase; banish cards your opponent controls up to the number of Tuners in your GY. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish this card you control until the End Phase; negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase. If this card is destroyed: You can Special Summon 1 "Red Nova Dragon" from your GY.

cards.name: Rustin Mammoth
cards.description: If this card is in your hand: You can banish Machine Link Monsters from your Extra Deck whose combined Link Ratings equal exactly 5; Special Summon this card. You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. This is a Quick Effect if this card is linked to a Link-3 or higher Machine Link Monster. You can only use each effect of "Rustin Mammoth" once per turn.

cards.name: Shade the Obscure
cards.description:
If you have a card in your Pendulum Zone and this card is in your hand: You can Special Summon this card. You can pay 1000 LP; destroy 1 Pendulum Monster Card in your hand or face-up field, then you can add 1 Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your face-up Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Shade the Obscure" once per turn.
[Pendulum Effect]
You cannot Pendulum Summon, except Pendulum Monsters (this effect cannot be negated). If a monster(s) with 1000 ATK or less is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can return this card to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Shade the Obscure" once per turn.

cards.name: Solemn Accusation
Solving for Pendulum
cards.description: Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Place 1 T Counter on this card. Once per turn: You can target 1 Pendulum Monster in your Main Monster Zone; for each T Counter on this card, move that Pendulum Monster to an adjacent (horizontal) Monster Zone, 1 move at a time. Then, after you have finished moving, destroy all Fusion or Xyz Monsters your opponent controls in the same (final) column, with an equal or lower Level/Rank than that monster's Pendulum Scale, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to their combined ATK they had on the field.

cards.name: Spiritual Art Familiars
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Familiar-Possessed" card.)
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Possessed" Spell/Trap or 1 "Grand Spiritual Art - Ichirin" from your Deck to your hand. You can declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; this card becomes that Type and Attribute until the end of this turn. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster with 1500 DEF from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Spiritual Art Familiars" once per turn.

cards.name: Starving Venom Wing Dragon
cards.description:
1 Fusion Monster + 1 "Clear Wing" monster
Once per turn, if your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; this card gains ATK equal to that monster's ATK, and if it does, that monster's effects are negated. These changes last until the end of this turn. Once per turn, when another card or their effect is activated on the field (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 card on the field. If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can place this card in your Pendulum Zone.
[Pendulum Effect]
Each time a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field, place 1 Predator Counter on it, and if it is Level 2 or higher, it becomes Level 1 as long as it has a Predator Counter.

cards.name: Subspace Battle
cards.description:
Apply the following effect, 3 times, in sequence.
● Each player reveals 1 monster from their Deck that does not have ? ATK. Add the monster with the higher ATK to the hand of the player that revealed it, also destroy the monster with the lower ATK and inflict 500 damage to the player that revealed it. If tied, shuffle those monsters into the Decks.
For the rest of this turn, neither player can activate the effects of monsters with any of their revealed monsters' names. You can only activate 1 "Subspace Battle" per turn.

cards.name: Summon Shock
cards.description: Each time a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned, place 1 Summon Counter on this card (max. 4). If the 4th Summon Counter is placed on this card: Remove all Summon Counters from this card, and if you do, send all monsters on the field to the GY.

cards.name: Super Duper Polymerization
cards.description:
Pay 2000 LP, then target 1 Effect Monster on the field; Special Summon 1 monster from your Extra Deck, with the same Type and Attribute but a different Level (but negate its effects), then apply 1 of these effects. Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.
● Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using the Special Summoned monster and the targeted monster.
● Send the Special Summoned monster to the GY.
You can only activate 1 "Super Duper Polymerization" per turn.

cards.name: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher
cards.description:
2 Level 10 monsters
During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 Machine monster, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). You can only use each of the following effects of "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Flying Launcher" once per turn. If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can add 1 EARTH Machine monster or 1 "Barrage Blast" from your Deck to your hand. You can detach any number of materials from this card, then target that many Spells/Traps on the field; destroy them.

cards.name: Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket
cards.description:
3 Level 10 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket" by discarding 1 card and using 1 "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max" you control (transfer its materials). When your opponent activates a monster effect, while this card has material (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. You can only use this effect of "Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Rocket" once per turn. Once per turn, during your End Phase: Detach 1 material from this card or destroy this card.

cards.name: Tails of the Fairy Tails
cards.description: The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Spellcaster Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand, field, and/or "Prince of Fairies" your opponent controls as material. If this card is in your GY: You can equip this card to 1 "Fairy Tail" monster on the field, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 Spellcaster monster with 1850 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Tails of the Fairy Tails" once per turn.

cards.name: Teller of Fairy Tails
cards.description:
1 LIGHT "Fairy Tail" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
"Fairy Tail" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Teller of Fairy Tails" once per turn. If this card is Fusion Summoned using "Prince of Fairies" as material: You can destroy as many cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to your opponent for each card destroyed. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Fairy Tail" card from your hand or GY; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

cards.name: The Crimson King
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner DARK monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 card that mentions "Red Dragon Archfiend" from your Deck to your hand. When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Synchro Summon), and if you do, its ATK becomes doubled, also it cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each effect of "The Crimson King" once per turn.

cards.name: Trito Enneacraft - "exapatisIA"
cards.description:
FLIP: Destroy 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls, and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster from your hand in face-down Defense Position.
When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Sets a card(s) (Quick Effect): You can change this face-down card to face-up Defense Position; add 1 "Enneacraft" card from your Deck to your hand. You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand in face-down Defense Position. You cannot Special Summon the turn you activate this effect, except in face-down Defense Position.
[Pendulum Effect]
Each time a monster(s) is flipped face-up, place 1 E.C. Counter on this card. You can pay 900 LP; reveal 3 "Enneacraft" cards from your Deck, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to add to your hand, shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Trito Enneacraft - "exapatisIA"" once per turn.

cards.name: Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity
cards.description:
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck or GY) by returning 3 monsters (1 Fusion, 1 Synchro, and 1 Xyz) from your face-up field and/or GY to the Extra Deck. Unaffected by monster effects, except "Power Patron" monsters. If this card is added to your Extra Deck face-up: You can add 1 "Power Patron" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) all cards in the GYs.
[Pendulum Effect]
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy this card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Power Patron" monster from your hand or GY.
● Destroy this card, also for the rest of this turn, "Power Patron" monsters you control whose original Level is 12 gain 5000 ATK.
You can only use this effect of "Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity" once per turn.

cards.name: VIP Whale
cards.description: You can Tribute additional monsters when you Tribute Summon this card face-up. If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can place VIP Counters on this card equal to the number of monsters Tributed for its Tribute Summon. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can remove 1 VIP Counter from this card; toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, negate that effect. If you call it wrong, this card's original ATK becomes halved until the end of this turn.

cards.name: WAKE CUP! Kuro
cards.description:
FLIP: You can target 1 other face-up monster on the field; change it to face-down Defense Position.
You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 WIND Flip monster from your Deck to your hand, except "WAKE CUP! Kuro", then discard 1 card. (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-down Defense Position monster on the field; change it to face-up Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "WAKE CUP! Kuro" once per turn.

cards.name: Weaver of Fairy Tails
cards.description:
1 "Fairy Tail" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
All "Prince of Fairies" on the field become Spellcaster monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 "Fairy Tail" monster from your Deck or banishment. You can only use this effect of "Weaver of Fairy Tails" once per turn. If you Normal or Special Summon a non-EARTH "Fairy Tail" monster, while this card is in your Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, also its name becomes "Prince of Fairies".

cards.name: Stage of Destiny
cards.description: You can activate this card the turn it was Set, by revealing 1 Normal Monster in your hand. Special Summon up to 5 Normal Monsters from your hand and/or GY in Attack Position, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn after this card resolves. You can only activate 1 "Stage of Destiny" per turn.

cards.name: Archfiend's Origin
cards.description: If this card is in your hand: You can Tribute 1 other "Archfiend" monster from your hand or field; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 6 Fiend monster with 2500 ATK from your hand, Deck, or GY. When your opponent activates a monster effect and you control "Summoned Skull" (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use each effect of "Archfiend's Origin" once per turn.

cards.name: Makourai, the Lightning Strike
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
Target 1 "Archfiend" monster you control; it gains 600 ATK, then you can destroy all monsters your opponent controls with lower original ATK than that monster's ATK. During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 6 Fiend monster with 2500 ATK in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makourai, the Lightning Strike" once per turn.

cards.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Toon Dragon
cards.description:
"Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon" + 2 Toon monsters
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by shuffling the above cards from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck/Extra Deck. Your Toon monsters can attack directly. Once per turn: You can add 1 "Toon" card, or 1 card that mentions a "Toon" card's name, from your GY to your hand. During damage calculation, if your Toon monster is attacked: You can banish it until the end of the Damage Step.

cards.name: Comic Cat
cards.description: This card is treated as a Toon monster while "Toon World" is on the field. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster (if you control "Toon World", you can Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls, even though you do not control it), and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Toon World" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only use this effect of "Comic Cat" once per turn.

cards.name: Dark-Eyes Illusionist Faceless Mage
Evil Box
cards.description: If you control "Toon World": You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add to your hand or Set 1 "Toon" Trap from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Evil Box" once per turn. This card is treated as a Toon monster while "Toon World" is on the field. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card in either GY; place it on the bottom of the Deck.

cards.name: Funny Dark Rabbit
cards.description: After this card is Normal or Special Summoned, you can Normal Summon 1 monster that mentions "Toon World" during your Main Phase this turn, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (you can only gain this effect once per turn). This card is treated as a Toon monster while "Toon World" is on the field. Once per turn: You can add to your hand or place face-up on your field, 1 "Toon" Field or Continuous Spell from your Deck.

cards.name: Reincarnation of the Unchained
cards.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Unchained" Spell (except "Reincarnation of the Unchained") or 1 "Abomination's Prison" from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn: You can target up to 3 "Unchained" cards in your GY, except "Reincarnation of the Unchained"; shuffle them into the Deck, then you can destroy other cards you control up to the number shuffled. You can only activate 1 "Reincarnation of the Unchained" per turn.

cards.name: Toon World the Perfect World
cards.description: This card's name becomes "Toon World" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn: You can add 1 "Toon" card, or 1 card that mentions a "Toon" card's name, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Toon World the Perfect World" thrice per turn. Before resolving another activated card or effect, you can banish 1 Toon monster you control until immediately after that card/effect resolves, also you cannot banish monsters with that same original name with this effect of "Toon World the Perfect World" for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Unchained Enma Lord Yama
cards.description:
2+ monsters, including an "Unchained Soul" monster
During your End Phase: You can target up to 2 Fiend monsters in your GY that were destroyed and sent there this turn; Special Summon them, but you cannot Special Summon, except Fiend monsters, while you control either of those face-up monsters. If this card on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 face-up card on either field instead. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Enma Lord Yama" once per turn.

cards.name: Unchained Malevolent Magistrate Kamura
cards.description:
You can target up to 3 cards you control; destroy them, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can apply any of the following effects, in sequence, based on the original types of the destroyed cards.
● Monster: Draw 1 card.
● Spell: Change the battle position of 1 monster on the field.
● Trap: Destroy 1 other card on the field.
If this card on the field is destroyed by card effect: You can destroy all monsters on the field. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Malevolent Magistrate Kamura" once per turn.

cards.name: Unchained Ogre Shara
cards.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your hand, then destroy 1 card you control. If a card(s) on the field is destroyed by card effect, except by the effect of "Unchained Ogre Shara", or by battle, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card (but place it on the bottom of the Deck when it leaves the field) or add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Ogre Shara" once per turn.

cards.name: Unchained Ogre Shma
cards.description: If this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Unchained" monster from your Deck, except "Unchained Ogre Shma", then destroy 1 card you control, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Fiend monsters. If this card on the field is destroyed by card effect, except "Unchained Ogre Shma", or by battle: You can Special Summon 1 "Unchained" monster from your hand or Deck, except "Unchained Ogre Shma". You can only use each effect of "Unchained Ogre Shma" once per turn.

cards.name: Unchained Soul Rage Abominator
cards.description:
2+ monsters, including a Fiend monster
If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; destroy 1 Fiend monster you control, and if you do, negate the targeted monster's effects until the end of this turn. When a monster effect is activated on the field and you control a Link-4 or higher "Unchained" Link Monster (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; destroy the monster that activated that effect. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Soul Rage Abominator" once per turn.

cards.name: Unchained Syncretism
cards.description: Target 2 face-up monsters on the field, including an "Unchained Soul" Link Monster you control; immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 Fiend monster using only those 2 monsters. If this Set card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Unchained" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Unchained Syncretism" once per turn.

cards.name: Witchcrafter Celebration
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy 1 "Witchcrafter" monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Witchcrafter" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling Spellcaster monsters from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck.
During your End Phase, if you control a "Witchcrafter" monster, while this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use 1 "Witchcrafter Celebration" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Witchcrafter Distortion
cards.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated and you control a Level 5 or higher "Witchcrafter" monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; add 1 Level 5 or higher Spellcaster monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Distortion" once per turn.

cards.name: Witchcrafter Madame Rilliona
cards.description:
"Witchcrafter Madame Verre" + 2 Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 3 Level 7 or lower "Witchcrafter" monsters with different Attributes from your hand and/or Deck, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters. During your End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can reveal 1 Spell in your hand; Special Summon this card in Defense Position. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Madame Rilliona" once per turn.

cards.name: Witchcrafter Marka
cards.description: You can Tribute this card from your hand or field; add 1 "Witchcrafter" Field or Continuous Spell from your Deck to your hand. If a face-up "Witchcrafter" monster(s) you control leaves the field by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card (but banish it when it leaves the field), and if you do, Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Marka" once per turn.

cards.name: Witchcrafter Pupils
cards.description:
1 "Witchcrafter" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster

● Add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell from your Deck to your hand.
● Reveal 1 "Witchcrafter" Normal or Quick-Play Spell in your hand; apply that Spell's activation effect.
During your End Phase: You can return 1 of your banished "Witchcrafter" cards to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Pupils" once per turn.

cards.name: Witchcrafter Terracottan
cards.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 "Witchcrafter" card in your GY, except "Witchcrafter Terracottan"; add it to your hand, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "Witchcrafter" monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Witchcrafter" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Witchcrafter Terracottan" once per turn.

cards.name: Witchcrafter Walpurgis
cards.description: During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Witchcrafter" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Witchcrafter Walpurgis" once per turn. During your turn, if you would discard to activate the effect of a "Witchcrafter" monster you control, you can send 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY instead, except "Witchcrafter Walpurgis".

cards.name: Armament Reincarnation
cards.description: Special Summon "Armament Reincarnation Tokens" (Warrior/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 500/DEF 500) up to the number of Equip Spells, and Traps with an effect that equips themselves to a monster, in your GY, then you can destroy as many cards in your Spell & Trap Zone as possible, including this card, then Set as many Equip Spells, and Traps with an effect that equips themselves to a monster, as possible from your GY. These Traps can be activated this turn. For the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon.

cards.name: Black Jack the Shadow-Armored Knight
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
Cannot be destroyed by battle. Each time a card(s) is placed in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone: Excavate cards from the top of your Deck until you excavate a monster, equip it to this card as an Equip Spell, also place the rest on the bottom of the Deck in any order. Gains ATK/DEF equal to the total Levels of the monsters equipped to this card x 300. If the total Levels of the monsters equipped to this card is greater than 21, destroy this card.

cards.name: Champion's Pulse
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● During your opponent's Battle Phase: Your opponent gains 1000 LP, then end the Battle Phase.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect while they control more cards than you do: Special Summon 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" or "Hot Red Dragon Archfiend" from your Extra Deck or GY, and if you do, negate that activated effect, and if you do that, destroy that monster.
You can only activate 1 "Champion's Pulse" per turn.

cards.name: Constellar Castor
cards.description:
If this card is Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Constellar" monster from your Deck, except "Constellar Castor", also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT and DARK monsters. You can only use this effect of "Constellar Castor" once per turn. A "Constellar" Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains this effect.
● Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 2 materials from a monster(s) you control, and if you do, negate that effect, and if you do that, destroy that card.

cards.name: Dragunity Divine Wind
cards.description:
During your Main Phase: You can apply 1 of these effects, or if "Dragon Ravine" is in your GY, you can apply both, in sequence.
● Add 1 Dragon or Winged Beast monster from your GY to your hand.
● Special Summon 1 "Dragunity" monster from your hand, then you can equip 1 Dragon "Dragunity" monster from your Deck to it.
You can only use this effect of "Dragunity Divine Wind" once per turn.

cards.name: Dragunity Falchion
cards.description: You can banish this card from your hand or GY, then target 1 "Dragunity" monster you control; equip 1 Dragon "Dragunity" monster from your Deck or GY to it as an Equip Spell. You can send this card equipped to a "Dragunity" monster to the GY, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Dragunity Falchion" once per turn.

cards.name: Dragunity Knight - Areus
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
You can target face-up cards your opponent controls, up to the number of face-up Monster Cards in your Spell & Trap Zone; negate their effects until the end of this turn. This is a Quick Effect if this card is equipped with an Equip Card. While this card is equipped to a monster: You can Special Summon this card, then you can Special Summon 1 "Dragunity" Tuner from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Dragunity Knight - Areus" once per turn.

cards.name: Dragunity Lord - Georgius
cards.description:
2+ monsters, including a Tuner
Your opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters in the GY while this card is equipped with a "Dragunity" card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dragunity Lord - Georgius" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned, or your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher "Dragunity" monster from your Extra Deck or GY. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Equip Card you control to the GY; negate that effect.

cards.name: Dragunity Quirinus
cards.description: Your "Dragunity" monsters cannot be destroyed by battle while this card is equipped with an Equip Card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dragunity Quirinus" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Dragunity" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 other "Dragunity" Monster Card you control; return it to the hand/Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon 1 "Dragunity" monster from your hand.

cards.name: Early Palm Gets the Win
cards.description:
Once per turn, when an attack is declared involving your monster: You can roll a six-sided die and apply this effect to that monster you control based on the result until the end of this turn. If you activated this effect when an attack was declared involving 2 monsters in the same column, you choose the effect instead.
● 1 or 4: The first time it would be destroyed by battle or card effect, it is not destroyed.
● 2 or 5: It loses 500 ATK, also it is unaffected by activated Spell/Trap effects, except "Early Palm Gets the Win".
● 3 or 6: It gains 1000 ATK, also it can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase.

cards.name: Ebisu Shinsen Matsuri
cards.description: Once per Chain, if an Effect Monster(s) is Special Summoned (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; Special Summon 1 "Shinsen Token" (Aqua/WATER/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0) to its controller's opponent's field in Defense Position. Once per Battle Phase, at the start of the Battle Phase: You can destroy both this card and as many Tokens on the field as possible, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Ebisu Token" (Fairy/WATER/Level 7/ATK ?/DEF ?). This Token's ATK/DEF become the number of Tokens destroyed by this effect x 700.

cards.name: El Shaddoll Meshahrail
cards.description:
1 "Shaddoll" monster + 1 DARK monster + 1 EARTH monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell/Trap effects and by activated effects from opponent's monsters whose original Level/Rank is lower than this card's current Level. Once per turn: You can pay 800 LP; add 1 "Shaddoll" card or "Void" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Shaddoll" monster from your GY.

cards.name: Endless Bond
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Xyz" card.)
When this card is activated: You can Special Summon 1 "Number 39: Utopia" from your GY, and if you do, it gains ATK equal to the total ATK of all LIGHT "Utopia" and "Utopic" Xyz Monsters in your GY. When your attacking "Utopia" or "Utopic" Xyz Monster whose original Attribute is LIGHT destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can make that monster you control lose 1000 ATK, and if you do, it can attack again in a row. You can only activate 1 "Endless Bond" per turn.

cards.name: Endymion Empire
cards.description: When this card is activated: Add 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" or 1 monster that mentions it from your Deck to your hand, then if your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 Spellcaster monster from your hand. If a card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your hand or face-up Monster Zone instead. You can only use this effect of "Endymion Empire" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Endymion Empire" per turn.

cards.name: Exstellarknight Constellar Ptolemy Ω7
cards.description:
3 Level 7 monsters
Once per turn, during your Main Phase 2, you can also Xyz Summon "Exstellarknight Constellar Ptolemy Ω7" by using a "tellarknight" or "Constellar" Xyz Monster you control (transfer its materials). While you have 7 or more "tellarknight" monsters with different names in your GY and/or banishment, this card gains 2700 ATK/DEF, also it is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach any number of materials from this card, then target that many monsters your opponent controls; shuffle them into the Deck.

cards.name: Fallen Angel in Darkness
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Darklord" card.)
Send 1 Fairy monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Darklord" monster from your hand, Deck, or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions. You can only activate 1 "Fallen Angel in Darkness" per turn.

cards.name: Fallin' Cheatah
cards.description: This face-up card in the Monster Zone cannot be Tributed, nor used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field, while this card is in the Monster Zone: Target 1 of them; give control of this card to that monster's controller, also that monster cannot be Tributed nor used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz or Link Summon while this monster is face-up on the field.

cards.name: Gagaga Escape
cards.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect while you control a "Gagaga" monster: Negate the activation, then you can discard 1 card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Gagaga" monster from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; change as many "Gagaga" monsters you control as possible to Defense Position, and if you do, "Gagaga" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Gagaga Escape" once per turn.

cards.name: Gagaga Illusion
cards.description: If you control a "Gagaga" monster: Target 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon it, then you can make its Level/Rank become equal to the Level/Rank of 1 "Gagaga" monster you control. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 "Gagaga" monster. You can only use each effect of "Gagaga Illusion" once per turn.

cards.name: Genni, the Maid of Endymion
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Witchcrafter" card.)
If you control a Spellcaster monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Spellcaster monster you control; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Witchcrafter" monster from your Deck, except "Genni, the Maid of Endymion". You can only use each effect of "Genni, the Maid of Endymion" once per turn.

cards.name: Junk Armor
cards.description: Your opponent cannot target Synchro Monsters you control with "Warrior" or "Stardust" in their original names, with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Junk Armor" once per turn. If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Junk" or "Synchron" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Junk Armor".

cards.name: Junk Meister
cards.description: You can reveal 1 "Warrior" or "Stardust" Synchro Monster in your Extra Deck; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Monsters. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Junk" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Junk Meister". You can target 1 "Junk" monster you control; reduce its Level by up to 2. You can only use each effect of "Junk Meister" once per turn.

cards.name: Learning Elf
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 Trap from your Deck with an effect that equips itself to a monster. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Learning Elf" once per turn.

cards.name: Lev Shaddoll Fusion
cards.description: When this card is activated: Send 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY. You can Tribute 1 Fusion Monster; Special Summon 1 "Shaddoll" Fusion Monster with a different Attribute from your Extra Deck (this is treated as a Fusion Summon), but change its ATK to 0. You can only use each effect of "Lev Shaddoll Fusion" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except "Shaddoll" monsters.

cards.name: Masked HERO Fountain
cards.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "HERO" monster from your hand in Defense Position. If this card is sent to the GY by card effect, or to activate a card effect: You can Set 1 "Mask Change" from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Masked HERO Fountain" once per turn.

cards.name: Mirror Barrier
cards.description:
Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to it as an Equip Card with this effect.
● Once per battle, during the Battle Step, if the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster: You can destroy that opponent's monster.
If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 "Armament Reincarnation" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Mirror Barrier" once per turn.

cards.name: Over Tuning
cards.description: If you control a Tuner: Special Summon 1 Tuner from your hand, Deck, or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Over Tuning" per turn.

cards.name: Pair Bear Scare!!
cards.description: Your opponent can reveal 1 "Pair Bear Scare!!" in their hand or Deck, and if they do, each player gains 2000 LP. Otherwise, you destroy 1 monster your opponent controls. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Add this card to your opponent's hand. You can only use this effect of "Pair Bear Scare!!" once per Duel. You can only activate 1 "Pair Bear Scare!!" per turn.

cards.name: Penetration Fusion
cards.description:
If a monster(s) was destroyed by battle this turn: Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field, and if you do, it gains this effect.
● (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card, then target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains 500 ATK.
You can only activate 1 "Penetration Fusion" per turn.

cards.name: Poisonous Viper
cards.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon it, or if your opponent controls no monsters, Special Summon it to their field in Defense Position instead. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 500 damage. If this card is banished, or sent to the GY by card effect: You can target 1 Set Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy it. It cannot be activated in response to this effect's activation. You can only use this effect of "Poisonous Viper" once per turn.

cards.name: Reeshaddoll Wendikurhu
cards.description:
1 "Shaddoll" monster + 1 WIND monster
Must first be Fusion Summoned. (Quick Effect): You can change any number of face-down monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position, then you can change other face-up monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position up to the number of Flip monsters flipped face-up. You can only use this effect of "Reeshaddoll Wendikurhu" once per turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Shaddoll" card in your GY; add it to your hand.

cards.name: Regulus, the Prince of Endymion
cards.description: The first time this card would be destroyed by battle each turn, it is not destroyed. You can only use each of the following effects of "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other Spellcaster monster in your hand; you lose LP equal to the revealed monster's Level x 300, and if you do, Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell that mentions "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Regulus' Arrow
cards.description:
If you control "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion": Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls that battled this turn.
● When a Normal or Quick-Play Spell Card is activated: Negate that effect.
During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" or 1 monster that mentions it in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Regulus' Arrow" once per turn.

cards.name: Stellarnova Bonds
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Xyz Monsters.
● Discard 1 card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "tellarknight" or "Constellar" monster from your Deck with a different Type from the monsters you control.
● Target face-up monsters your opponent controls, up to the number of "tellarknight" and "Constellar" monsters you control; negate their effects until the end of this turn.
You can only activate 1 "Stellarnova Bonds" per turn.

cards.name: Surprise Fusion
cards.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control and declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; that monster becomes that Type and Attribute, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters you control, including the targeted monster. You can banish this card from your GY; Tribute 1 Fusion Monster, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Surprise Tokens" (Spellcaster/DARK/ATK 0/DEF 0) with a Level equal to the Level the Tributed monster had on the field. You can only use this effect of "Surprise Fusion" once per turn.

cards.name: Tellarknight Constellar Delteros
cards.description:
3+ Level 4 monsters
Your opponent cannot target Rank 5 or higher "tellarknight" or "Constellar" Xyz Monsters you control with card effects. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "tellarknight" or "Constellar" monster from your Deck to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 LIGHT monster. If this card is sent to the GY, except from the field: You can Special Summon 1 "tellarknight" or "Constellar" monster from your hand or banishment.

cards.name: Tellarknight Cygnian
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Constellar" card.)
If this card is Summoned: You can add 1 "tellarknight" or "Constellar" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 other LIGHT monster you control; increase both its Level and this card's by 1. This card can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a "tellarknight" Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials. You can only use each effect of "Tellarknight Cygnian" once per turn.

cards.name: Theorealize
cards.description: Send 1 "Medius the Pure" from your Deck to the GY; look at the top card of your opponent's Deck, and place it on the top or bottom of the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster you control and declare 1 Monster Type and 1 Attribute; that monster becomes that Type and Attribute, until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use each effect of "Theorealize" once per turn.

cards.name: Thorn Fangs of Violet Poison
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Predap" card.)
Target 1 "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon" you control; it cannot attack for the rest of this turn, also destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible with less ATK than that monster, then you can discard your entire hand, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monsters.

cards.name: Tohushaddoll Grysta
cards.description:
FLIP: You can target 1 non-Rock "Shaddoll" monster in your GY; apply its effect that activates when it is flipped face-up.
If this card is sent to the GY by card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Fusion Summon 1 "Shaddoll" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing its materials from your hand, field, and/or GY. You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except "Shaddoll" monsters. You can only use 1 "Tohushaddoll Grysta" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Unbreakable Xyz Barrier
cards.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control an Xyz Monster: Negate the activation, then you can detach 2 materials from a monster(s) you control, then destroy 1 card on the field. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 LIGHT "Utopia" or "Utopic" Xyz Monster from your GY to it. You can only use each effect of "Unbreakable Xyz Barrier" once per turn.

cards.name: Void Unleashing
cards.description: Reveal 1 "Shaddoll" card in your hand; add 2 "Shaddoll" cards from your Deck to your hand of different types (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from the revealed card and each other, then discard 1 card. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Infernoid" monster from your Deck or GY your hand. You can only use each effect of "Void Liberation" once per turn.

cards.name: Griffoh
cards.description:
(Quick Effect): You can discard this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● The next battle or effect damage you take this turn will become 0.
● Set 1 Quick-Play Spell or Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck. It can be activated this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Griffoh" once per turn. If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 Level 8 Ritual Monster with a card effect that requires use of monsters, this card can be used as the entire Tribute.

cards.name: Arcana Force XII - The Hangman
cards.description:
When a card or effect is activated (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Arcana Force" monster from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Arcana Force XII - The Hangman" once per turn. If this card is Summoned: Toss a coin.
● Heads: Destroy 1 monster you control, and if you do, take damage equal to its original ATK.
● Tails: Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK.

cards.name: Candelato, the Beast of Light
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Phantom Beast" card.)
Gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand. You can only use each of the following effects of "Candelato, the Beast of Light" once per turn. You can discard 2 other cards; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 card from your Deck to your hand that has a coin tossing effect. When a card or effect is activated that includes an effect that adds a card(s) from the Deck to the hand (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect.

cards.name: D - Burst
cards.description: Target 1 face-up Spell you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 1 card, then if you control a "Destiny HERO" monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your hand, GY, or banishment. At the end of the Damage Step, if a monster equipped with an Equip Card, or "Destiny HERO - Dogma", attacked: You can banish this card from your GY; that monster can make a second attack in a row. You can only activate 1 "D - Burst" per turn.

cards.name: Dark Tyranno
cards.description: Can attack directly if all monsters your opponent controls are in Defense Position. You can only use each of the following effects of "Dark Tyranno" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if a Spell Card or effect was activated this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Level 8 or higher Dinosaur monster from your Deck to your hand, then you can Special Summon it if your opponent controls a monster.

cards.name: Doll Hammer
cards.description: Target 1 monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 2 cards, then you can change the battle position of 1 monster your opponent controls. If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Doll Hammer" once per turn.

cards.name: Elemental HERO Clay Guardian
cards.description:
1 "Elemental HERO" monster + 1 Warrior monster
(This card is not treated as a "Guardian" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck, then if your opponent controls a card, you can inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except "HERO" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Elemental HERO Clay Guardian" once per turn. Other "Elemental HERO" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.

cards.name: Invincible Demise Lord
cards.description: During the End Phase, if a monster(s) was destroyed by battle this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, and if "Invincible Demise Lord" was destroyed by battle this turn, this card's original ATK becomes 3000, also it cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your Main Phase: You can reveal cards in your Deck, including "Slash Draw", equal to the number of cards your opponent controls +1 and place those revealed cards on top of the Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Invincible Demise Lord" once per turn.

cards.name: Plasma Warrior Eitom
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Magna Warrior" card.)
Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or higher monster. You can only Special Summon "Plasma Warrior Eitom" once per turn this way. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Magnet Warrior" or "Magna Warrior" monster from your Deck to the GY, except "Plasma Warrior Eitom"; for the rest of this turn, this card's original ATK becomes 1500, also it can attack directly.

cards.name: Quick Summon
cards.description: Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster. When you do, if your opponent controls a monster, you can Normal Summon a Level 5 or higher monster without Tributing. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; add 1 Level 5 or higher monster that can be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck or GY to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon it. You can only use this effect of "Quick Summon" once per turn.

cards.name: The Magical King of Dimension Zeta
cards.description: ''The observer of the void. Through every rift and distortion in spacetime, it contemplates all things in existence. Take heed. Whenever you peek through a door, Zeta peeks into your world in return.''

cards.name: White Knight Lord
cards.description:
You can banish 3 monsters from your GY; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 "White Knight" or "White Night" monster from your hand or Deck.
● Add 1 "White Veil" from your Deck to your hand.
You can only use this effect of "White Knight Lord" once per turn. When an attack is declared involving this card and an opponent's monster: Change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Abyss of the Sacred Beasts
cards.description: You can send 3 face-up "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" you control to the GY, including this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position. You can only use each of the following effects of "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn. During the Main Phase: You can place 2 "Abyss of the Sacred Beasts" from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, face-up on your field. During your opponent's End Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can place this card on the bottom of the Deck.

cards.name: Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law
cards.description: You can banish this card from your hand or field; add 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if this effect was activated on the field, immediately after this effect resolves, you can Normal Summon 1 Spellcaster monster. If a face-up Fusion Monster(s) you control is sent to the GY, except by battle, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, then you can Fusion Summon 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each effect of "Aiwass, Divine Spirit of the Law" once per turn.

cards.name: Aleister the Reminiscent
cards.description: If this card is in your hand: You can target 1 Spellcaster monster or 1 Fusion Monster on the field; Special Summon this card, and if you do, the targeted monster gains 1000 ATK until the end of this turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or flipped face-up: You can banish 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck; add 1 "Invocation", or 1 Spell that mentions it, from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Aleister the Reminiscent" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Bastion
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 other card in this card's column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can place 1 "Angelechy Shatranga" from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Bastion" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, other "Angelechy" cards on the field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects.

cards.name: Angelechy Destrier
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 monster in another column; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Spell from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Destrier" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each time your opponent activates a card or effect, inflict 500 damage to your opponent when it resolves.

cards.name: Angelechy Disturbance
cards.description: Give control of 1 "Angelechy" monster you control to your opponent (until the End Phase), then if your opponent controls a face-up card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, their effects are negated. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Disturbance". You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Disturbance" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Enlisted
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner
You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column; banish it, then change control of this card by moving it to one of your opponent's Main Monster Zones in this card's adjacent columns. If the control of this face-up card changes: Return this card to the Extra Deck, then the owner of this card Special Summons 1 "Angelechy" monster from their Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Enlisted" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Opening to e4
cards.description: If your opponent goes first, you can also activate this card from your hand during the Standby Phase of their first turn. Place 1 "Angelechy" Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up on your field, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 2 or 7 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to the Extra Monster Zone, and if you do that, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. Until the end of your next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters.

cards.name: Angelechy Problem
cards.description: Once per turn: You can discard 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon 1 Level 2 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck, and if you do, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. If a face-up "Angelechy" Monster Card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it.

cards.name: Angelechy Shatranga
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can add 1 "Angelechy" Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Shatranga" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, your opponent can only attempt to activate up to 5 monster effects per turn.

cards.name: Annihilate Retroglight
cards.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field, except monsters that were Summoned this turn: Negate that activation, then you can banish (face-down) all face-up monsters your opponent controls, except monsters Summoned this turn. If this Set card in its owner's control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can Set 1 Trap from your Deck.

cards.name: Astrazma Urania
cards.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by returning 1 or 2 monsters you control to the hand. You can only Special Summon "Astrazma Urania" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Astrazma Urania" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can reveal any number of monsters in your hand with different Levels, then target that many face-up cards your opponent controls; negate their effects. If this card on the field is destroyed by card effect and sent to the GY: You can add this card to your hand.

cards.name: Black Chaos
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by shuffling 1 Spellcaster or Warrior Ritual Monster from your hand or GY into the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Black Chaos" once per turn this way. You can discard this card; place 1 Continuous Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck or GY, face-up on your field. While you have a Ritual Spell in your GY, this card is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can banish 2 cards your opponent controls.

cards.name: Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Light and Darkness Ritual". Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, unless they target this card, also cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Black Luster Soldier - Soldier of Light and Darkness" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can make this card gain 1500 ATK, and if you do, it can make a second attack in a row.

cards.name: Blitzclique - Breakaway
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Place 1 "Blitzclique" Continuous Trap from your Deck, face-up on your field.
● Return 1 Thunder monster you control to the hand, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it.
If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Breakaway" once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique - Steppleader
cards.description: If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 Thunder monster in your GY; add it to your hand. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, then destroy this card. If a card(s) is destroyed by your "Blitzclique" card's effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Blitzclique - Steppleader" once per turn.

cards.name: Blitzclique Alternator
cards.description: Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder monster you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Alternator" once per turn. You can shuffle 1 other "Blitzclique" card from your hand or face-up field into the Deck; add 1 Thunder monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Blitzclique" Spell or "Hideout in the Sky, Coulomb" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Blitzclique Return Stroke
cards.description: "Blitzclique" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Blitzclique Return Stroke" once per turn. When your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect: You can return 1 "Blitzclique" monster you control to the hand; negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Blitzclique" monster in your field or GY; return it to the hand.

cards.name: Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with the effect of a "Sacred Beast" card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Sacred Beast" Spell from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Calamity of the Sacred Beasts - Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder" once per turn. Once per turn, if a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can activate this effect; you take no damage this turn.

cards.name: Celtic Mystic
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can reveal your entire hand, and if you revealed a card that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual", you can draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards, also for the rest of this turn, you can only Special Summon once from the Extra Deck. You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Ritual Monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand. You can only use each effect of "Celtic Mystic" once per turn.

cards.name: Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can banish (face-up) 1 Beast monster from your hand or face-up field until the End Phase; Special Summon 1 EARTH Beast monster from your Deck or GY, with an equal or lower Level than that monster's original Level, then your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their hand. You can only use this effect of "Cerynemesia, Mystical Beast of the Forest" once per turn. Your opponent's monsters that can attack must attack the monster you control with the highest ATK (their choice, if tied).

cards.name: Chaos Magical Hats
cards.description: When your opponent activates a monster effect, or a Normal Spell/Trap Card: Choose 3 Spells/Traps with different names from your Deck and 1 monster in your Main Monster Zone that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual". Special Summon the Spells/Traps as Normal Monsters (Spellcaster/DARK/Level 8/ATK 0/DEF 0) in face-down Defense Position (their names become "Chaos Magical Hats" even while face-down), Set the chosen monster if it is face-up, and shuffle them on the field. Then your opponent's activated effect becomes "Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls in face-down Defense Position".

cards.name: Chaos Mystic Box
cards.description: When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets another card(s) you control: Return 1 of your targeted cards to the hand (if face-down, reveal it), and if you do, destroy 1 card on the field, then you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" with a different name than the card returned to the hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon 1 Ritual Monster that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your hand or Deck.

cards.name: Clown Crew Dristy
cards.description:
2 Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and/or Pendulum Monsters
Your Tribute Summoned monsters can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. If this card is Tributed: You can activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Clown Crew Dristy" once per turn);
● Return all Link Monsters from the field and the GYs to the Extra Deck.
● Each player with a hand shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards they shuffled into the Deck.
cards.linkLooser: Ritual; Fusion; and/or; "synchro" (the game holds two conditions for every material)

cards.name: Clown Crew Finale
cards.description: If you control a Tribute Summoned monster: Discard any number of cards, then target that many face-up cards on the field; destroy them. You can banish this card from your GY, and Tribute 1 Ritual, Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Pendulum, or Link Monster from your hand or field; add 1 "Clown Crew" monster with a different original Level/Rank/Link Rating from your Deck or GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Clown Crew Finale" once per turn.

cards.name: Crackle Blitzclique
cards.description: During your opponent's turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; destroy that monster, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can send 1 "Blitzclique" Spell/Trap from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Crackle Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Distrust Paranoia
cards.description:
Take control of all your opponent's monsters in this card's column. If this Set card in its owner's control has left the field by an opponent's effect, and is now in the GY or banished: You can Special Summon this card as an Effect Monster (Fiend/DARK/Level 10/ATK 4000/DEF 4000) with the following effect (this card is NOT treated as a Trap).
● Unaffected by your opponent's card effects activated in the same column.
You can only activate 1 "Distrust Paranoia" per turn.

cards.name: Elfnote June Pride
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner Spellcaster monster
While this card is in the center Main Monster Zone, neither player can declare attacks, except with monsters in their center Main Monster Zones. During the Main Phase, if this card is in the center Main Monster Zone (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon up to 1 "Elfnote" monster each from your hand, Deck, and GY. You can only use this effect of "Elfnote June Pride" once per turn.

cards.name: Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession
cards.description: The monster in your center Main Monster Zone cannot be banished by your opponent's card effects. You can send 1 other Spell/Trap from your hand or field to the GY, then declare a Level from 1 to 4; Special Summon 1 "Elfnote Seraphim Token" (Plant/Tuner/FIRE/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the declared Level. While that Token is in the Monster Zone, the player who Summoned it cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Elfnote" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Elfnotes: Quatrain of Succession" once per turn.

cards.name: Emi Blitzclique
cards.description: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can reveal this card, then target 1 card on the field; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. If another card(s) is destroyed by card effect, while this card is in the Monster Zone (except during the Damage Step): You can add 1 "Blitzclique" Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Emi Blitzclique" once per turn.

cards.name: Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts
cards.description: Up to thrice per turn, during your Main Phase: You can send 3 other cards of the same type (Monster, Spell, or Trap) from your hand and/or face-up field to the GY, then you can Special Summon 1 "Sacred Beast" monster from your hand, Deck, GY, or banishment, and if you do, it is unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell/Trap effects. If you control a "Sacred Beast" monster whose original Level is 10: You can draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Fallen Paradise of the Sacred Beasts" once per turn.

cards.name: Foolish Trap Hole
cards.description: When a monster effect is activated on your opponent's field, during a turn your opponent has Special Summoned: Destroy the monster that activated its effect, then if your opponent controls a card(s) in its adjacent Monster Zones and/or Spell & Trap Zones, destroy them.

cards.name: Gamma Summon
cards.description: Banish 1 "Aleister" monster or 1 Fusion Monster from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but banish it during the End Phase. If a monster is banished face-up, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of your banished "Invoked" monsters; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Gamma Summon" once per turn.

cards.name: Garden of Talistones
cards.description: While you control 5 cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, any battle damage a player takes is halved, also once per turn, you can activate 1 Continuous Trap Card the turn it was Set. During the Standby Phase: You can reveal 5 Continuous Traps from your Deck with different names, your opponent randomly picks 1 for you to Set, and shuffle the rest into the Deck. You can only use this effect of "Garden of Talistones" once per turn.

cards.name: Glitch Clutch Nullgainer
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can add 1 Level 8 or higher monster with 0 ATK from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 monster with 0 ATK in your GY; Special Summon it, but negate its effects, also it cannot be used as material for a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, or Link Summon. You can only use each effect of "Glitch Clutch Nullgainer" once per turn.

cards.name: Grain Blitzclique
