You can only use this effect of "Trirealm Rift Territory - Valvols" once per turn. While you control a Level 5 or higher "Trirealm Rift" monster and you have no cards in your Deck, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects during your turn.

cards.name: Zenet Cataract
cards.description: Choose opponent's Main Monster Zones equal to the number of Normal Monsters and "Zenet" Ritual Monsters you control; negate the first monster effect activated in each of those zones that resolves this turn. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Cataract" once per turn.

cards.name: Zenet Per Akh
cards.description: Add 1 "Zenet" monster from your Deck to your hand. If you discard a "Zenet" Ritual Monster(s) while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with ATK less than or equal to any of the discarded monsters' as a Normal Monster Card, but for the rest of this turn, it cannot attack directly, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Per Akh" once per turn.

cards.name: Zenet Prophet - Amenhotep
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send it to the GY; show up to 2 Normal Monster Cards from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Set that many "Zenet" Traps from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 3 Normal Monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Prophet - Amenhotep" once per turn.

cards.name: Zenet Prophet - Nefertari
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send it to the GY; show up to 2 Normal Monster Cards from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Set that many "Zenet" Spells from your Deck. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; equip 1 Normal Monster from your GY to 1 Ritual Monster you control as an Equip Spell. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Prophet - Nefertari" once per turn.

cards.name: Zenet Thunderfall
cards.description: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card while you control a Normal Monster or "Zenet" Ritual Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 "Zenet" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY, except "Zenet Thunderfall". You can only use each effect of "Zenet Thunderfall" once per turn.

cards.name: Zenetmes Nekhbet
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Zenet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenetmes Nekhbet" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Zenet" card from your GY to your hand, except "Zenetmes Nekhbet". (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 face-up Normal Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone, and if you do, equip this card you control to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 2500 ATK.

cards.name: Zenetnakht Sphinx
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Zenet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Zenetnakht Sphinx" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Zenet" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Zenetnakht Sphinx". (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up Normal Monster Card you control to the GY; change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY.

cards.name: Armor Wizard Pazoo
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Prophecy" card.)
If this card is in your hand or GY: You can target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to it as an Equip Spell with the following effects. You can only use this effect of "Armor Wizard Pazoo" once per turn.
● The equipped monster gains 2100 ATK/DEF while your LP are 4000 or less.
● When a card or effect activated by your opponent resolves, if you control a card with an effect that requires a die roll, you can negate the activated effect, then banish this card.

cards.name: Archfiend of Gilfer - Flame Attack
cards.description: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; draw 1 card, then discard 1 card, also all monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK this turn. When a monster is destroyed by battle involving your Fiend monster, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Archfiend of Gilfer - Flame Attack" once per turn.

cards.name: Aroma Strategy
cards.description:
Once per turn: You can declare 1 card name; reveal the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, you can apply this effect based on its card type. If it is not, destroy this card.
● Monster: Special Summon it.
● Spell/Trap: Set it.
If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck or GY.

cards.name: Attribute Rejection
cards.description: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; send 1 DARK or Zombie monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY, and if you do, the targeted monster loses ATK equal to the sent monster's original ATK, then if the targeted monster is LIGHT, negate its effects. You can only activate 1 "Attribute Rejection" per turn. If this card was activated as Chain Link 3 or higher, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

cards.name: Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon
cards.description: If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 DARK Machine monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon". During the Battle Phase, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there from the field this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon it, and if you do, toss a coin 3 times, then you can destroy monsters on the field up to the number of heads.

cards.name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant
cards.description:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"
Cannot be destroyed by card effects, also unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during your opponent's turn. Can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase. Once per Chain, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster that was Special Summoned this turn, or 1 face-down card, that your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant" thrice per turn.

cards.name: Dark Necrofear, the Ruler of Demise
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by card effect. If you have 3 or more Fiend and/or Zombie monsters in your GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card on the field is destroyed: You can add this card to your hand, and if you do, take control of 1 monster your opponent controls (until the End Phase), then you can inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its ATK. You can only use each effect of "Dark Necrofear, the Ruler of Demise" once per turn.

cards.name: Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion
cards.description:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Level 7 or higher monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for every other monster on the field. Can attack all your opponent's monsters, once each. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then you can destroy 1 card on the field. After this card destroys a card by battle or card effect and sends it to the GY, neither player can activate its effects while it is in the GY.

cards.name: Evil Dragon Cards - Earth Dragon
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing 3 EARTH monsters in your hand, including this card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dragon Card" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then if a WATER monster is on the field, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Evil Dragon Cards - Earth Dragon" once per turn.

cards.name: Evil Dragon Cards - Metal Dragon
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing 3 LIGHT monsters in your hand, including this card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dragon Card" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, send this card to the GY, then if an EARTH monster is on the field, you can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Evil Dragon Cards - Metal Dragon" once per turn.

cards.name: Exodia the Obliterator
cards.description: When you draw this card during your turn: You can reveal it; Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned during your turn: You can activate this effect; for the rest of this turn, neither player can activate cards or effects, except "Exodia the Obliterator", also you cannot Normal or Special Summon monsters. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles: You can destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the total original ATK of those destroyed monsters.

cards.name: Final Journey of the Soul
cards.description: When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a Monster Card(s) from the GY: Negate that effect, and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's GY to their field, then send any number of face-up monsters they control to the GY whose total ATK equal 6000 or less. If this card is banished: You can add it to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves (except during the Damage Step), you can Normal Summon 1 monster from your hand that requires 1 or more Tributes without Tributing. You can only use each effect of "Final Journey of the Soul" once per turn.

cards.name: Flashforce Sword
cards.description:
Banish (face-up) 1 random card from your opponent's hand (until the Standby Phase of the next turn), then if this card was Set before activation and it banished a monster, you can apply this effect based on its Level.
● 4 or lower: Your opponent banishes all monsters with its same name from their hand, Deck, and GY.
● 5 or higher: Add 1 Level 5 or higher monster with the same Type, Attribute, and/or Level from your Deck to your hand.
You can only activate 1 "Flashforce Sword" per turn.

cards.name: Gearfried the Steel Knight
cards.description: If a monster(s) you control was destroyed by battle or card effect this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, equip 1 monster from your GY to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 800 ATK. During your Main Phase: You can destroy as many cards equipped to this card as possible, then if you destroyed a Monster Card by this effect, you can add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand with the same Attribute and Type as 1 of them, but a different Level. You can only use each effect of "Gearfried the Steel Knight" once per turn.

cards.name: Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts
cards.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters, and if you Tributed a monster(s) that is owned by your opponent, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when this card is Special Summoned this way. If Summoned this way: Your opponent must send all monsters they control to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts" once per turn.

cards.name: Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist
cards.description: This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while on the field or in the GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a WIND or EARTH monster: You can Special Summon this card. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 2 Level 5 "Harpie" monsters from your hand, Deck, and/or GY, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WIND or EARTH monsters.

cards.name: King of Yamimado
cards.description: While you control a face-down card, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also your opponent cannot target it with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "King of Yamimado" once per turn. If this card is in your hand, and "Yami" and/or 2 or more face-down cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card. When a monster on the field with less ATK than this card activates its effect or declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can destroy that monster.

cards.name: Knight of Twin Swords
cards.description: Can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Knight of Twin Swords" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a card with an effect that requires a die roll: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can roll a six-sided die 3 times, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the total x 350 (until the end of this turn), then if 2 or more of the results were the same, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

cards.name: Penalty Game "GREED, the Illusion of Avarice"
cards.description: If your opponent added a card(s) from the Deck to the hand this turn, except during the Draw Phase: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand, then if the total number of cards in their hand, field, and GY is 20 or more, you can banish their entire hand. You can only activate 1 "Penalty Game "GREED, the Illusion of Avarice"" per turn.

cards.name: Perfect Eclosion - Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having 6 or more Insect monsters in your GY. You can only Special Summon "Perfect Eclosion - Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can return as many cards your opponent controls as possible to the hand, then if you have a Normal Monster in your GY, you can make this card gain 300 ATK for each Insect monster in your GY. Each time your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): All monsters your opponent currently controls lose ATK equal to their own Level x 100.

cards.name: Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion". Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can Tribute 2 monsters; Special Summon this card (this is treated as a Ritual Summon). During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, and if you do, equip it to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 2000 ATK.

cards.name: Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or lower monster (Spellcaster or Warrior). You can only Special Summon "Silent Magician, the Silent Fighter" once per turn this way. The first time this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Twice per turn, each time your opponent draws a card(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card, or if your opponent drew by their own card effect, you draw the same number of cards instead. While you have 6 or more cards in your hand, negate all your opponent's activated Spell Cards and effects.

cards.name: Spell Card "Enemy Controller"
cards.description:
Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; apply 1 of these effects.
● Destroy it.
● Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon 1 monster by Tributing monsters including the targeted opponent's monster, even though you do not control it.
During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Spell Card "Enemy Controller"" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Spell Card "Enemy Controller"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Super Critical
cards.description:
When this card is activated: You can add 1 card with an effect that requires a die roll from your Deck to your hand. Once per Chain per player, if either player rolls a 1 for a card effect's die roll (except during the Damage Step): They can activate 1 of these effects;
● They destroy up to 3 monsters their opponent controls.
● They destroy 1 monster their opponent controls, and if they do, they negate the effects of 1 monster their opponent controls.
● They Special Summon 1 monster from their GY.
You can only activate 1 "Super Critical" per turn.

cards.name: Zombyra
cards.description: When this card declares an attack: You lose 500 LP, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK. When a monster is destroyed by battle: You can equip this card from your GY to the monster that destroyed that monster, then you can destroy the 1 monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). The equipped monster's name becomes "Zombyra", also its effects are negated. When the equipped monster declares an attack: Its controller loses 500 LP, and if they do, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK.

cards.name: The Dark Dragon Lord of Ultum
cards.description: ''A dragon from another star that awoke from within a sealed underground world. It's a well-known fact even in Dimension Zeta that when you first wake up, you can only exert one-thousandth of your true strength.''

cards.name: Adamancipator Conductor
cards.description: If this card is in your hand: You can place 1 other "Adamancipator" card from your hand on top of the Deck; Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, and if you do, you can Special Summon 1 excavated Level 4 or lower Rock monster, also place the rest on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Conductor" once per turn.

cards.name: Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite
cards.description: If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of an "Adamancipator" card: You can add 1 "Adamancipator" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite", then you can Special Summon 1 Rock monster from your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Rock Synchro Monster in your field or GY; return it to the Extra Deck, and if you do, place this card on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Crystal - Tiamite" once per turn.

cards.name: Adamancipator Luminous
cards.description:
2 Effect Monsters, including a Synchro Monster
If this card is Link Summoned, or a monster(s) is Special Summoned to a zone(s) this card points to: You can target 1 monster in your face-up field or GY; Special Summon 1 "Dwimmered Stone Token" (Rock/LIGHT/ATK 0/DEF 0) with the same Level as that monster. When an effect of another monster on the field is activated (Quick Effect): You can place that monster on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Luminous" once per turn.

cards.name: Adamancipator Mates
cards.description: Add 1 "Adamancipator" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is in your GY: You can place 1 card from your hand on top of the Deck; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Mates" once per turn.

cards.name: Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If you have a DARK monster in your GY: You can add 1 "Adamancipator" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can excavate the top 5 cards of your Deck, and if you do, you can return cards your opponent controls to the hand, up to the number of excavated Rock monsters, also place the excavated cards on the bottom of your Deck in any order. You can only use each effect of "Adamancipator Risen - Tiamite" once per turn.

cards.name: Advent of Atlantis
cards.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while in the Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use each of the following effects of "Advent of Atlantis" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can place 1 "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" or "Umi" from your Deck, face-up in your Field Zone. If this card is sent to the GY: You can add 1 Level 7 Sea Serpent monster from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Akasuna the Battle Ashtra
cards.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand or Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Akasuna the Battle Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Akasuna the Battle Ashtra" once per turn. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Trap from your hand or face-down field to the GY; change all face-up monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Ashtra" Trap from your Deck.

cards.name: Alligator's Dragon Knight
cards.description: Can attack directly. You can only use each of the following effects of "Alligator's Dragon Knight" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other card that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" in your hand; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add up to 2 Spells/Traps with different names that mention "Dark Time Wizard", from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Angelechy Brilliant Move
cards.description: Return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can banish this card from your GY, then send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Brilliant Move" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Castellan
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
You can target 1 opponent's monster in this card's adjacent column, or 1 card in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone that is 2 columns away from this card's; banish that card. If this card is placed in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: You can send 1 "Angelechy" card from your Deck to the GY. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Angelechy Castellan" once per turn. While this card is treated as a Continuous Spell, each player can only activate 1 card or effect per Chain.

cards.name: Angelechy Endgame Problem
cards.description:
This card gains the following effects, based on the number of "Angelechy" Monster Cards in your Spell & Trap Zone.
● 1+: Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: You can draw 1 card.
● 2+: When your opponent would Special Summon a monster(s), you choose the zone(s) to place it.
● 3+: Once per turn, you can activate 1 "Angelechy" Trap Card the turn it was Set.
● 4+: Once per turn, when your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish that monster(s).
● 5: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck.

cards.name: Angelechy Opposition
cards.description: Choose 2 "Angelechy" monsters in your Extra Deck, with different names than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, Special Summon 1 of them in your opponent's Main Monster Zone, and place the other in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can banish this card from your GY; shuffle up to 5 "Angelechy" cards into the Deck from your GY and/or banishment, except "Angelechy Opposition". You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this card, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Angelechy Opposition" per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Seneschal
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: Activate this effect; each player can Special Summon 1 Fairy Synchro Monster from their Extra Deck (but negate its effects), also this card, and monsters Special Summoned by this effect, cannot be used as material for an Xyz or Link Summon, and return them to the Extra Deck when they leave the field. If an "Angelechy" monster targets this card for an attack: Negate that attack, and if you do, give control of this card to your opponent. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Seneschal" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Strategy Score
cards.description: Add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Angelechy Strategy Score", also for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except LIGHT or DARK Synchro Monsters. If this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent there: You can banish it; return 1 "Angelechy" Monster Card you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Strategy Score" once per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Verdict
cards.description:
Apply this effect based on the number of "Angelechy" Monster Cards on the field.
● 1 to 4: Negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls.
● 5+: Banish all cards your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY; send 1 "Angelechy" card from your hand or face-up field to the GY, then you can place 1 "Angelechy" monster with a different name than the cards in your Spell & Trap Zone, from your Extra Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. You can only use each effect of "Angelechy Verdict" once per turn.

cards.name: Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer
cards.description:
2 WATER monsters
You can send 1 card you control to the GY; all WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF this turn. If a WATER Link Monster(s) you control is destroyed by an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of those destroyed monsters; Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand or GY, with a Level less than or equal to that monster's Link Rating. You can only use each effect of "Archidux, the Squid Sorcerer" once per turn.

cards.name: Ars Magna "Citrinitas"
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Artmage", "DoomZ", and "Elfnote" card.)
While you control a "Power Patron" Link Monster, you can activate the effects of monsters you control with "Ars Magna" in their original names, as Quick Effects. Once, while this card is face-up on the field, during your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Medius" or "Ars Magna" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Ars Magna "Citrinitas"" once per turn.

cards.name: Ars Magna "Philosophorum"
cards.description: Target up to 3 "Ars Magna" monsters in your field or GY; banish them, then until the end of this turn, you can negate the effects of up to that many other face-up cards on the field. You can banish this card from your GY; return 1 "Power Patron" Link Monster from your GY to the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon it. You can only use 1 "Ars Magna "Philosophorum"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification
cards.description: You can banish this card from your hand; add 1 "Ars Magna" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, also until the end of the next turn, the first three times each "Power Patron" Link Monster you control would be destroyed by battle, it is not destroyed. If an Xyz or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can target Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of "Power Patron" Link Monsters you control; banish them. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification" once per turn.

cards.name: Ars Magna the Division and the Union
cards.description: You can banish this card from your hand; Special Summon 1 non-Spellcaster "Ars Magna" monster from your GY or banishment, also your "Power Patron" Link Monsters can make up to 3 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase this turn. If a Synchro or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. You can banish 1 "Ars Magna" card from your GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Division and the Union" once per turn.

cards.name: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
cards.description: You can banish this card from your hand; add 1 non-Warrior "Ars Magna" monster from your Deck to your hand, also for the rest of this turn, the original ATK of all "Power Patron" Link Monsters you control become tripled. If a Fusion or Link Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is banished (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card. If you control a "Power Patron" Link Monster: You can target 1 monster on the field; banish it. You can only use each effect of "Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite" once per turn.

cards.name: Ashtra's Domain
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Aqua/Tuner/WATER/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect, and your opponent controls no face-down cards: Negate that effect.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Domain" per turn.

cards.name: Ashtra's Howl
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Spellcaster/Tuner/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● If you have an "Ashtra" monster in your field or GY: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Howl" per turn.

cards.name: Ashtra's Web
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon this card as a Normal Monster (Insect/Tuner/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) (this card is NOT treated as a Trap), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 Synchro Monster.
● Target 1 "Ashtra" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.
You can only activate 1 "Ashtra's Web" per turn.

cards.name: Ashtraja Susanoo
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can banish any number of Traps from your GY; banish that many cards from the field. During the End Phase: You can target up to 2 "Ashtra" monsters and/or "Ashtra" Traps in your GY and/or banishment; add to your hand or Set each card, then if you targeted 2 cards, return this card to the Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Ashtraja Susanoo" once per turn.

cards.name: Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond
cards.description: You can target any number of face-down cards you control; add "Ashtra" cards from your Deck to your hand, except Field Spells, each with a different name, equal to the number of those face-down cards, then send those face-down cards to the GY. If you control an "Ashtra" monster and a face-down card, and either player Sets a card: You can target 1 card on the field; return it to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond" once per turn.

cards.name: Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can send 1 "Ashtra" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, send 1 card on the field to the GY. You can only use this effect of "Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto" once per turn. If your opponent activates a monster effect (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 "Ashtra" Trap in your GY or banishment, or if 3 or more cards are face-down on the field, you can target any 1 Trap in your GY instead; Set it.

cards.name: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
cards.description: While a monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" is on the field, the Levels of all monsters in both players' hands and on the field are reduced by 1. When you Link Summon a "Daedalus" Link Monster, you can reduce the total number of materials by 1 (from Link Rating and from mentioned materials). If this card is in your GY and you control "Umi": You can place this card face-up on your field. You can only use this effect of "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" once per turn.

cards.name: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
cards.description: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

cards.name: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage
cards.description:
4 monsters
This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. If this card is Link Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 3 monsters that mention "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your GY to your zone this card points to, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send all cards on the field to the GY, except "Umi".

cards.name: Barian's Hope
cards.description: Special Summon 1 "Umbral Horror" monster or 1 "Masquerade" Xyz Monster from your hand or GY, then you can make the Levels of all "Umbral Horror" monsters you control the same as 1 "Umbral Horror" monster in your field or GY. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 "Number" Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck or GY to it. You can only use each effect of "Barian's Hope" once per turn.

cards.name: Barian's Seal
cards.description: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, while you control a "CXyz" monster, or a monster with "Number C101" through "Number C107" in its name: Negate that activation, then you can attach 1 monster from the field or either GY to 1 Xyz Monster you control. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 2 "Umbral Horror" monsters from your GY. You can only use 1 "Barian's Seal" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Barian's Seventh Untopia
cards.description: Neither player can Special Summon from the Extra Deck more than 2 times per turn, except "Number" monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Barian's Seventh Untopia" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. During the End Phase: Each player takes damage equal to the number of Xyz Monsters on the field x 400.

cards.name: Bingo!
Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned by its own effect. If this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 Quick-Play or Ritual Spell; Special Summon this card in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Black Skull Dragon, the Archfiend of Unity" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Light and Darkness Ritual" from your Deck or GY. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can make your opponent lose 800 LP, and if you do, this card gains 800 ATK.

cards.name: Blitzclique Overvolt
cards.description: Target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon Effect Monsters, except from the hand. You can only use this effect of "Blitzclique Overvolt" once per turn.

cards.name: Call of Atlantis
cards.description: Add 1 monster that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand, then if you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon", you can negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn. If you control "Umi": You can banish this card from your GY; WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF. You can only use each effect of "Call of Atlantis" once per turn.

cards.name: Cartoon Shade
cards.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) while a monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set is face-up on the field. You can only Special Summon "Cartoon Shade" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 monster with 2000 ATK or DEF that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck to your hand. If this card on the field is Tributed: You can target 1 card on the field, or target 2 if you control a monster with 2000 ATK or DEF; return them to the hand.

cards.name: Chaospawn Bishop

If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Chaospawn Bishop" from your hand, Deck, or GY, and if you do, it becomes LIGHT, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon, except LIGHT or DARK monsters, and you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Synchro Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Chaospawn Bishop" once per turn.

cards.name: Clown Crew Cappello
cards.description:

● Shuffle all Pendulum Monsters from the face-up Extra Decks and the field into the Deck.

[Pendulum Effect]
During your Main Phase: You can send 1 non-Pendulum "Clown Crew" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card, also until the end of the next turn after this effect resolves, you cannot activate the effect of monsters Special Summoned from the Deck or Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Clown Crew Cappello" once per turn.

cards.name: Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon

You can only use this effect of "Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon" once per turn.

cards.name: Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse

● Special Summon 1 monster from among those cards.
● Set 1 Spell/Trap from among those cards, except "Crow, the Carrion Cutpurse". If you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn.

cards.description:
2 Level 3 monsters

If this card destroys a monster by battle: Place 1 Crown Counter on this card, then apply this effect based on the number of Crown Counters on this card.
● 1: It gains 400 ATK. ● 2: It gains 600 ATK. ● 3: Return it to the Extra Deck, and if you do, draw 3 cards.

cards.name: CXyz Hope Chaos Barian Dragon

3+ Level 7 monsters

Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; attach the top 2 cards of your opponent's Deck to this card.

cards.name: Daedalus Maelstrom
cards.description: When your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s), while you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon": Negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s), then if you control a WATER Link Monster, you can destroy all monsters on the field, except WATER monsters. You can only use 1 "Daedalus Maelstrom" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Dark City at Midnight
cards.description: Each time you Special Summon a Level 8 or higher "Destiny HERO" monster(s): Warrior monsters you control gain 300 ATK. cards.name: Dark Time Wizard

If Summoned this way: You can activate this effect; during the next Standby Phase, inflict 2000 damage to your opponent. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 Warrior or DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling its materials from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck.

cards.name: Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish it until the next Standby Phase. You can send 1 "Destiny HERO" monster from your Deck to the GY; add 1 "Clock Tower Prison" or "Dark City at Midnight" from your Deck or GY to your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK "HERO" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Destiny HERO - Doom Overlord" once per turn.

cards.name: Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Master
cards.description:
2 Level 5 or higher "Destiny HERO" monsters

You can only Special Summon "Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Master" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 2 cards from your Deck to your hand, that are "Destiny HERO" monsters and/or mention a "Destiny HERO" monster by name. This card's ATK becomes the total original ATK of other "Destiny HERO" monsters in your field and GY.

cards.name: Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant
cards.description: If you control a "Destiny HERO" monster or a face-up Field Spell: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can destroy 1 card you control, and if you do, add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand. If you Special Summon a Level 8 "Destiny HERO" monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; place it on top of the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Destiny HERO - Dreadnought Servant" once per turn.

cards.name: Elemental Saga Doriado

You can only use each effect of "Elemental Saga Doriado" once per turn, also neither player can activate cards or effects in response to either of these effect activations.

cards.name: Father Grizzly
cards.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster with 1400 ATK from your Deck, or if you have 2 or more Level 4 monsters with 1400 ATK in your GY, you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster instead. You can only use this effect of "Father Grizzly" once per turn.

cards.name: Fisherman of Legend

If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy it, also during the End Phase of this turn, return this card from the field to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Fisherman of Legend" once per turn.

cards.name: Foolish Graverobber
cards.description:
Send 1 card that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY, except "Foolish Graverobber", then you can Special Summon 1 monster from either GY to your field. You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 of the following cards to your field.
● Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" in your GY, except "Foolish Graverobber"
● Spell/Trap in your opponent's GY
You can only use each effect of "Foolish Graverobber" once per turn.

cards.name: Garbage Golem
cards.description: If you control a monster with 0 ATK or DEF: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can banish this card from your GY; detach 1 material from a monster you control, then you can Special Summon 1 monster with 0 ATK or DEF from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Garbage Golem" once per turn.

cards.name: Gorgonic Umbral Horror
cards.description: You cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except "Number" Xyz Monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "Gorgonic Umbral Horror" once per turn. Can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a "Number" Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials.

cards.name: Graceful & Skull Dice
cards.description:
Roll a six-sided die twice, and apply these effects for the rest of this turn.
● All monsters you control that mention "Dark Time Wizard" gain ATK/DEF equal to the total x 200.
● All monsters your opponent controls lose ATK/DEF equal to the total x 200.
If your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s), while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 of those monsters; roll a six-sided die twice, and if the total was 6 or higher, destroy that monster.

cards.name: Half Slice of Nickeline
cards.description: If this card is Special Summoned from the Deck: You can add 1 Level 4 or lower Rock monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Half Slice of Nickeline". If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material, you can (except during the Damage Step): Immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon 1 Rock monster. You can only use each effect of "Half Slice of Nickeline" once per turn.

cards.name: Helping Robo for Underwater Combat
cards.description:
2 Machine monsters
If this card is Link Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; destroy that monster, also this card, then you can Special Summon 1 non-WATER Machine monster with 1600 or less ATK from your GY. If this card is banished: You can add 1 Machine monster whose ATK equals its own DEF from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helping Robo for Underwater Combat" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except Machine monsters.

cards.name: Invocation - "Grail"

1 "Aleister" monster + 1 monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck

● Destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.
When your opponent activates a card effect in the GY (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 "Aleister" monster from your Deck, and if you do, negate that activated effect. You can only use each effect of "Invoked De Anima" once per turn.

● Special Summon 1 monster from your GY.
● Set 1 Trap from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Just Flip a Coin" once per turn.

cards.name: Kerolia the Frolicsome

You can only use each effect of "Kerolia the Frolicsome" once per turn.

2+ Level 4 LIGHT and/or DARK monsters
