cards.name: Myriaday Dragon
cards.description: Once per turn, during the End Phase: You can pay 100 LP; place 1 Myriaday Counter on this card. Once per turn, during your Main Phase: You can place 1 Myriaday Counter on this card for every 1000 points difference between your LP and your opponent's. Gains 10000 ATK/DEF while this card has 10 or more Myriaday Counters. If this card would be destroyed by battle or card effect, remove 1 Myriaday Counter from this card instead.

cards.name: Number 104: Masquerade V
cards.description:
3 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; add 1 "Barian's" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. You can only use the following effect of "Number 104: Masquerade V" once per turn. An Xyz Monster that was Summoned using this card on the field as material gains this effect.
● If this card is Xyz Summoned: Activate this effect; your opponent can banish 4 monsters with different Attributes and 1 Spell from their Deck. If they did not, you banish the top 10 cards of their Deck.

cards.name: Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory
cards.description:
4 Level 5 monsters
Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. If this card battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation: This card's ATK/DEF become equal to that opponent's monster's ATK or DEF (whichever is higher) +100, during that damage calculation only. If this card destroys a monster by battle: Send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the GY, and if you do, halve your opponent's LP.

cards.name: Predaplant Daredevil
cards.description:
1 "Predaplant" monster + 1 Level 1 monster
Must first be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing 1 monster on either field with a Predator Counter and 1 "Predaplant" monster you control. During the Main Phase, if this card was Special Summoned this turn (Quick Effect): You can target Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of monsters with a Predator Counter; destroy them. You can only use this effect of "Predaplant Daredevil" once per turn.

cards.name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed
cards.description:
"Red-Eyes Black Dragon" + 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard"
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing 1 face-up monster on either field during the turn a monster was destroyed by the effect of "Dark Time Wizard". You can only Special Summon "Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Unaffected by your opponent's activated Spell or monster effects. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 8 or lower monster from your hand or GY.

cards.name: Revenge of the Paper Dolls
cards.description: Target 1 monster you control and 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy your monster, and if you do, negate the effects of that opponent's card until the end of this turn. If this Set card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Revenge of the Paper Dolls" once per turn.

cards.name: Reversal Box
cards.description: Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: Roll a six-sided die, and place counters on this card (max. 6), up to the result. When a monster effect is activated on your opponent's field, or once per battle, during damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks: You can remove 1 counter from this card, then target 1 of those monsters; toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck, and if you do, until the end of this turn, change the targeted monster's ATK to 0, also negate its effects.

cards.name: Sacred Beasts Skyfall
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● When your opponent activates a card or effect in response to your "Sacred Beast" monster's effect activation: Negate that effect.
● Reveal 1 Level 10 "Sacred Beast" monster in your hand; discard 1 card, and if you do, add 1 "Illusion Gate" from your Deck to your hand.
● Shuffle 3 "Sacred Beast" Traps from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck, then target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.
You can only activate 1 "Sacred Beasts Skyfall" per turn.

cards.name: Shining Umbral Horror
cards.description: If you Normal or Special Summon an "Umbral Horror" monster(s) or a "Masquerade" Xyz Monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card, then you can Special Summon it if it is an "Umbral Horror" monster. Can be treated as 2 materials for the Xyz Summon of a "Number" Xyz Monster that requires 3 or more materials. You can only use each effect of "Shining Umbral Horror" once per turn.

cards.name: Siren Vortex of Atlantis
cards.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Siren Vortex of Atlantis" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 card that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to the GY, except "Siren Vortex of Atlantis". If this card is sent to the GY and you control "Umi": You can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand.

cards.name: Skyborne Blue Cularsaw
cards.description:
1 Level 8 or higher DARK monster + 1 Warrior monster
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can equip 1 Warrior monster from your GY or banishment, or 1 monster from your opponent's GY or banishment, to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 500 ATK/DEF. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send 1 Equip Card you control to the GY; negate the activation. You can only use each effect of "Skyborne Blue Cularsaw" once per turn.

cards.name: Sleepy Scapegoats
cards.description: Special Summon up to 4 "Sacrificial Sheep Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position (they cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon this turn), then if your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Swiftwind Panther Warrior" from your Deck, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters. If a card(s) you control that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 Token you control that was Special Summoned by this effect instead.

cards.name: Spell Power Attainment
cards.description:
Add 1 card that mentions "Spell Counter" in its effect  from your Deck or GY to your hand, except "Spell Power Attainment", then if you control a Level 7 or higher "Endymion" Monster Card, you can apply this effect.
● Remove any number of Spell Counters from your field, and if you do, negate the effects of that many face-up cards your opponent controls, and if you do that, destroy those cards.
You can only activate 1 "Spell Power Attainment" per turn.

cards.name: Spell Shattering Sword
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects;
● Destroy all face-up Spells your opponent controls.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; show 1 "Light and Darkness Ritual" in your hand or GY, then that monster's ATK becomes 0, also its effects are negated.
 If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can destroy 1 card in your opponent's hand (at random) or their field. You can only activate 1 "Spell Shattering Sword" per turn.

cards.name: Stratiae the Stratasmasher Dino
cards.description:
2 monsters, including a Dinosaur monster
If this card is Link Summoned: You can make this card gain ATK equal to half the combined original ATK of the Dinosaur monsters used as Link Material. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Dinosaur Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by banishing its materials from your field or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Dinosaur monsters. You can only use this effect of "Stratiae the Stratasmasher Dino" once per turn.

cards.name: Swiftwind Panther Warrior
cards.description:
Cannot declare an attack unless a monster was Tributed this turn. During the Main Phase, if this card is on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other monster from your hand or field, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your hand or Deck, except "Swiftwind Panther Warrior".
● Send 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY.
You can only use this effect of "Swiftwind Panther Warrior" once per turn.

cards.name: The Great Gallant Bandit
cards.description: You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing monsters in your hand and/or your opponent's field, while you control no monsters. You can only use each of the following effects of "The Great Gallant Bandit" once per turn. When your opponent activates a card effect in the hand, GY, or banishment, and you control this Normal Summoned/Set card (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal your entire hand; change all monsters your opponent controls to Defense Position.

cards.name: Theorealized Medius
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Power Patron" card.)
If a "Power Patron" card is on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can add 1 "Theorealize" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If a monster is banished face-up (except during the Damage Step): You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Add 1 "Ars Magna" card from your Deck to your hand.
● Banish this card, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Diactorus" monster from your Extra Deck.
You can only use each effect of "Theorealized Medius" once per turn.

cards.name: Thousand Umbral Horror
cards.description: (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand or field to the GY; place 1 "Barian's Seventh Untopia" from your hand or Deck, face-up in your Field Zone, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck until the end of your next turn after this effect resolves, except Xyz Monsters. If an Xyz Monster(s) is Special Summoned, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card, also you take no effect damage from your card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Thousand Umbral Horror" once per turn.

cards.name: Tigress in Silent Repose
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that card when this card leaves the field. If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 Spell/Trap you control to the GY; Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Tigress in Silent Repose" once per turn.

cards.name: V Umbral Horror
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Umbral Horror" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "V Umbral Horror". You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Masquerade" Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number" monster that is 1 Rank higher than that monster you control, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials). You can only use each effect of "V Umbral Horror" once per turn.

cards.name: Verre, the Maid of Endymion
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Witchcrafter" card.)
Gains 2300 ATK while you have "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your field or GY. You can only use each of the following effects of "Verre, the Maid of Endymion" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if a Spell Card or effect was activated this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Witchcrafter" Spell/Trap or 1 "Magical Dimension" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Warchief of Atlantis
cards.description: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Warchief of Atlantis" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon" from your Deck to your hand. If you control "Umi" and this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card.

cards.name: Yoa the Plague Ashtra
cards.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 face-down card you control and returning it to the hand or Extra Deck. You can only Special Summon "Yoa the Plague Ashtra" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Yoa the Plague Ashtra" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can Set 1 "Ashtra" Spell/Trap from your Deck. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can target 1 face-up monster on the field; increase or decrease its Level by 1.

cards.name: Counter Spell "Negate Attack"
cards.description:
During the Battle Phase: Activate 1 of these effects;
● When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they control more monsters than you do: Negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect: Negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that monster.
When you draw for your normal draw in your Draw Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

cards.name: Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.description:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck.
● Extra Deck: Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your GY.
You can only use each effect of "Aitvaras, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 "Winter Raven" monster you control; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY, except "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven". You can only use each effect of "Anu, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: Ars Magna Academic Arcane Apparition Acropolis
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Artmage" card.)
Your activated "Medius" monsters' effects cannot be negated. If you have a "Power Patron" monster in your GY: You can banish 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster from your GY, and declare 1 "Ars Magna" Link Monster Card name that has not been declared for "Ars Magna Academic Arcane Apparition Acropolis" this turn; Special Summon that monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot be used as Link Material.

cards.name: Ars Magna Artmage
cards.description:
2+ monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "Artmage" monster
Your opponent cannot target your linked monsters with card effects. During your Main Phase: You can add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 "Ars Magna", "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" monster from your Deck, then if you have 3 or more different Monster Types on your field, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your GY or banishment. You can only use this effect of "Ars Magna Artmage" once per turn.
cards.linkLooser: "Ars Magna" (not a game archetype or card); or; "Artmage"

cards.name: Ars Magna DoomZ
cards.description:
2 monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "DoomZ" monster
Any monster destroyed by battle with your linked monster is banished. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ars Magna DoomZ" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can destroy, or banish, 1 card you control, then you can shuffle up to 2 cards from any GY(s) into the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "DoomZ" monster from your hand.
cards.linkLooser: "Ars Magna" (not a game archetype or card); or; "DoomZ"

cards.name: Ars Magna Elfnote
cards.description:
2 monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "Elfnote" monster
Your linked monsters gain 300 ATK for each different Monster Type on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ars Magna Elfnote" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can send to the GY, or banish, 1 card you control, then you can return 1 monster on the field to the hand. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Elfnote" monster from your hand.
cards.linkLooser: "Ars Magna" (not a game archetype or card); or; "Elfnote"

cards.name: Autumn
cards.description: This card's name becomes "Summer" while in the Field Zone. Once per turn: You can place Season Counters on this card equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can take 1 Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY that you can place a Season Counter on, except "Autumn", and place it face-up on your field, and if you do, place all Season Counters on this card on that card. If a card(s) in the Field Zone would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

cards.name: Bunnillin Extract
cards.description: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Extract" once per turn. If a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

cards.name: Bunnillin Soft
cards.description: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, Normal Monsters you control gain 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Soft" once per turn. You can target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY with different Types, Attributes, and Levels; Special Summon them. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Bunnillin: Mocha MOD
cards.description: You can send 1 Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Bunnillin" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY face-up on your field. If your opponent Special Summons an Effect Monster(s), while this card is in the Monster Zone: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Bunnillin: Mocha MOD" once per turn.

cards.name: Card Crawl
cards.description:
You can banish (face-down) the top 5, 10, or 15 cards of your Deck, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; apply the appropriate effect to it.
● 5: Its ATK/DEF become 0.
● 10: Negate its effects.
● 15: Banish it (face-down).
You can only use this effect of "Card Crawl" once per turn.

cards.name: Deep Forest of the Winter Raven
cards.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your Deck to your hand. "Winter Raven" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "Deep Forest of the Winter Raven" per turn.

cards.name: Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest
cards.description:
1 Fusion or Synchro Monster + 1 Spellcaster or Illusion monster
If this card is Special Summoned: You can place any number of monsters you control face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Spells, then you can return cards on the field to the hand up to the number of Spells/Traps you control. You can only use this effect of "Diabellze, Heiress of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. Gains 700 ATK/DEF for each Spell/Trap on the field. This face-up Fusion Summoned card cannot be used as Fusion Material.

cards.name: Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God
cards.description:
Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster by this effect during your opponent's turn, you can Special Summon it.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
You can only activate 1 "Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God" per turn.

cards.name: Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God
cards.description: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God
cards.description: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God", then if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, you can discard 1 random card from their hand. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: Heretic Eradicator
cards.description: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster, while this card is in your hand and your opponent has 4 or more monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set in their face-up field, GY, and/or banishment (Quick Effect): You can negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster, and if you do that, Special Summon this card (while you control no monsters, this effect and its activation cannot be negated). You can send this card from the field to the GY; halve the ATK of 1 monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Heretic Eradicator" once per turn.

cards.name: Illusion of the Winter Raven Witch
cards.description: Fusion Summon 1 Illusion Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Extra Deck and/or field, also you cannot activate monster effects in the hand or GY for the rest of this turn after this card resolves, except Illusion monsters'. If the activation of this card in its owner's possession was negated by an opponent's card effect and sent to your GY: You can Set this card, and if you do, return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only activate 1 "llusion of the Winter Raven Witch" per turn.

cards.name: Javelin Beetle of the Alliance
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use this effect of "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance" once per Duel. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can target 1 other card in this card's column; destroy it, and if you do, this card gains 600 ATK.

cards.name: Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights
cards.description:
2 Level 7 monsters
When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s) from the Deck (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; your opponent draws 1 card, then negate that activated effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During your Main Phase 2: You can target 1 Level 7 monster in your GY; take damage equal to its ATK, and if you do, return both it and this card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights" once per turn.

cards.name: Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God
cards.description:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

cards.name: Lethargisaurus
cards.description:
1 Defense Position Tuner + 1+ Defense Position non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned in Attack Position: Change it to Defense Position. This Defense Position card gains these effects.
● Change all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position.
● Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to the activation of their own cards or effects.
● Once per turn, during the End Phase: Each player gains 500 LP for each Defense Position monster they control.

cards.name: Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.description: You can send 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY; place this card face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and if you do, Special Summon up to 2 "Winter Raven" monsters with different names from each other from your Deck, except "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven". When a monster declares an attack and this card is a Continuous Spell: You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Mart, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: Omega Vidolium the Power Patron of Heaven's End
cards.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ] If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can return this card to the Extra Deck, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field, including a "Power Patron" monster you control.
[ Monster Effect ] 3 monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck with 3000 or more ATK
Must first be Fusion Summoned. Unaffected by card effects, except "Power Patron" cards'. When your opponent activates a monster effect while they control 2 or more monsters with the same Type as that monster (Quick Effect): You can banish (face-down) the top 3 cards of your Deck; negate the activation, and if you do, banish that monster face-down. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Place this card in your Pendulum Zone.
[Pendulum Effect]
If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can return this card to the Extra Deck, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field, including a "Power Patron" monster you control.

cards.name: Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-
cards.description: Discard 1 "Power Patron" card; place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck in your Pendulum Zone, then if it is a Fusion Monster, you can place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone. If you control a "Power Patron" monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1500 ATK, also it cannot attack this turn. You can only use each effect of "Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-" once per turn.

cards.name: Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest
cards.description: If you control a "Winter Raven" card, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Winter Raven" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sinful Spoils" card from your Deck to your hand. You can target 1 "Winter Raven" Monster Card or 1 Level 7 or 8 Monster Card in the Spell & Trap Zone; Special Summon it to your field.

cards.name: Reindsurm Amurusa
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 non-WIND "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Amurusa" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Butterfly
cards.description: Send 2 monsters from your Deck to the GY, including an Insect monster, also you cannot Special Summon until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, except Insect monsters. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; all "Reindsurm" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK/DEF. You can only use 1 "Reindsurm Butterfly" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Carcasas
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can send 2 "Reindsurm" cards from your Deck to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Carcasas" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Carnation
cards.description: While you control a "Reindsurm" monster whose original Level is 8 or higher or your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, the activated effects of your "Reindsurm" monsters cannot be negated. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Reindsurm" monster or Dragon monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original Level, but a different original name.

cards.name: Reindsurm Conquest
cards.description: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any number of Insect Ritual Monsters. You must also shuffle Insect and/or Dragon monsters from the GY(s) into the Deck whose total Levels equal or exceed the total Levels of the Ritual Monsters. If this card is in your GY: You can send 1 Insect monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Conquest" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Encounter
cards.description: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Reindsurm" monster: Negate the activation, then you can add 1 "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, and if you do, send 1 Insect monster you control to the GY. If a "Reindsurm" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can place this card from your GY on the bottom of the Deck instead. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Encounter" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Gigalovendra
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". (Quick Effect): You can send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, including this card; add 1 non-FIRE "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck to your hand. If this card is Ritual Summoned, or your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can shuffle up to 2 monsters on the field into the Deck. If this card and a WATER "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Gigalovendra" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Giriakarma
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". When your opponent activates a monster effect in the field or GY and you control this Ritual Summoned card (Quick Effect): You can negate the activation, then you can shuffle 1 monster each from both your opponent's field and GY into the Deck, also if either of them was a Dragon monster, double this card's ATK. If this card and a LIGHT "Reindsurm" monster are in your GY: You can add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Giriakarma" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Luvian
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Reindsurm Conquest". If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can add 2 "Reindsurm" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY, except by battle: You can Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field, and/or shuffling Insect and/or Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Luvian" once per turn.

cards.name: Reindsurm Practice
cards.description: Add 2 "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then if your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, you can add 1 Insect monster from your GY to your hand. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; place 1 "Reindsurm" Field Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Practice" once per turn.

cards.name: Salamangreat Bastella
cards.description: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are "Salamangreat" monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can increase or decrease the Level of 1 monster on the field by 1. If you Link Summon a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Set 1 "Salamangreat" Trap from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Bastella" once per turn.

cards.name: Salamangreat Gearblade
cards.description: Special Summon 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your hand or GY, and if you do, equip this card to it. You can send 1 "Salamangreat" monster from your Deck to the GY; the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the sent monster's Level x 300. If this card is in your GY: You can shuffle 3 "Salamangreat" cards from your GY into the Deck, except Equip Spells, and if you do, add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Gearblade" once per turn.

cards.name: Salamangreat Markhor
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Salamangreat" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. If this card is sent to the GY as material for a Link-3 or higher FIRE Link Monster: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE Cyberse monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Salamangreat Markhor" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon the turn you activate either of this card's effects, except FIRE monsters.

cards.name: Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest
cards.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by placing 1 Level 1 FIRE Monster Card from your face-up field or GY on the bottom of the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn this way. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the hand, then target 1 monster in the face-up field or either GY; place it face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. You can only use this effect of "Sinful Spoils of the Winter Raven's Forest" once per turn.

cards.name: Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch
cards.description:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 "Winter Raven" monster from your hand or GY.
● Fusion Summon 1 "Diabell" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using up to 1 "Winter Raven" monster each from your hand, Extra Deck, and/or field.
● If you control a "Diabell" monster: Target 1 face-up card on the field; negate its effects until the end of this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch" once per turn.

cards.name: Sun God Domination
cards.description:
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster is on the field: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 monster from each GY to your field.
● If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is on the field, take control of all monsters your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster; gain LP equal to the ATK it had on the field. You can only use each effect of "Sun God Domination" once per turn.

cards.name: The Immortal Sun God
cards.description: Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your GY or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then if you Special Summoned "The Winged Dragon of Ra" by this effect, you can send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Extra Deck. During the End Phase, send the monsters Special Summoned by this effect to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Sun God" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Immortal Sun God" once per turn.

cards.name: The Pyramid of Kepher
cards.description: Send 1 Zombie Ritual Monster from your Deck to the GY; place 1 Field Spell from your Deck or GY face-up on your field, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects for the rest of this turn after this card resolves. If your opponent controls an Effect Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Pyramid of Kepher" once per turn.

cards.name: The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor
cards.description: During your opponent's End Phase: You can place this card from your GY on top of the Deck. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can return this card from the field to the hand, and if you do, each player draws 1 card, then your opponent can draw 1 card, and if they do, you must keep your hand revealed during this Main Phase. (Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. You can only use each effect of "The Secret Crane Princess Who Returns A Favor" once per turn.

cards.name: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
cards.description: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.

cards.name: The Winged Dragon of Ra, Sun God of Darkness
cards.description:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

cards.name: Theorealize Ephemeral Lull
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Power Patron" card.)
Banish 1 "Medius" monster from your hand or face-up field; banish as many monsters on the field as possible that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon 1 "Artmage" monster from your GY. If you have 3 or more different Monster Types on your field: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 of your banished "Medius" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Theorealize Ephemeral Lull" once per turn.

cards.name: Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God
cards.description: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven
cards.description:
1 Illusion Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; return them to the hand. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect based on where it was sent from;
● Field: Set 1 "Winter Raven" Trap from your Deck.
● Extra Deck: Add 1 "Winter Raven" card from your GY to your hand.
You can only use each effect of "Zaltys, Knight of the Winter Raven" once per turn.

cards.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon, the White Phantom Beast
cards.description: When this card is added from the Deck to your hand, or a monster you control is destroyed by battle: You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned from the hand or Deck: You can destroy all monsters your opponent controls, also you can only attack directly with "Blue-Eyes" monsters for the rest of this turn. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Blue-Eyes White Dragon, the White Phantom Beast" once per turn. When a card or effect is activated that targets this card on the field (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate that effect.

cards.name: Borreload Liberator Dragon
cards.description:
3+ Effect Monsters
You can only Special Summon "Borreload Liberator Dragon(s)" once per turn. Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can place 1 monster your opponent controls in a zone this card points to and take control of it. Your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation. Once per Chain, if this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

cards.name: Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
(This card is always treated as a "Speedroid" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned: You can destroy 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to that monster's original ATK. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WIND Tuner from your hand or GY (but negate its effects), then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Synchro Summon 1 WIND Synchro Monster. You can only use each effect of "Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

cards.name: Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl
cards.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
Gains ATK equal to the total original ATK of all other Synchro Monsters you control. You can only use each of the following effects of "Crimson Dragon Quetzalcoatl" once per turn. If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can Special Summon as many Dragon Synchro Monsters from your GY as possible, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn. When your opponent activates a monster effect (Quick Effect): You can return 1 other Dragon Synchro Monster you control to the Extra Deck, and if you do, negate that activation.

cards.name: Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon
cards.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only use each of the following effects of "Cyber Dragon, the Luminous Mech Dragon" once per turn. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control and monsters from your hand or field.

cards.name: Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon
cards.description:
3 Machine monsters with 2100 or more ATK
Must be Fusion Summoned. If this card is Fusion Summoned using only LIGHT monsters: You can pay 4000 LP; add 1 "Limiter Removal" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Cyber End Dragon, the Final Strike Dragon" once per turn. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. While its ATK is higher than its original ATK, this card can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase.

cards.name: Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
cards.description:
2 Level 4 DARK monsters
(This card is always treated as a "The Phantom Knights" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target an equal number of cards on each field; destroy them. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 Rank 4 DARK Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck, using this card you control (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer this card's materials). You can only use each effect of "Dark Rebellion Xyz Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

cards.name: Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss
cards.description:
(This card is always treated as a "Blue-Eyes" card.)
You can discard this card; add 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner from your Deck to your hand. If a "Blue-Eyes" Ritual Monster(s) and/or "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" is sent to your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 of them; Special Summon this card from your GY (if it was there when the monster was sent) or hand (even if not), and if you do, its ATK becomes that monster's, also banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Deep-Eyes White Dragon, the Blue Abyss" once per turn.

cards.name: Future Fusion Nova
cards.description: When this card is activated: Fusion Summon 1 LIGHT Machine Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your Deck, including "Cyber Dragon", also for the rest of this turn after this effect resolves, you cannot Special Summon, except Machine monsters, and you cannot declare attacks, except with the Summoned monster. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card. You can only activate 1 "Future Fusion Nova" per turn.

cards.name: Galaxy Defense Robot Orbital 7
cards.description: You can Tribute this card from your hand or field; take 1 "Photon" monster and 1 "Galaxy" monster from your Deck, add 1 of them to your hand, and send the other to the GY, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except LIGHT monsters. If a "Galaxy-Eyes" monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your GY, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Galaxy Defense Robot Orbital 7" once per turn.

cards.name: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon
cards.description: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 2 face-up monsters with 2000 or more ATK from anywhere on the field, including a monster you control. You can only Special Summon "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon" once per turn this way. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish this card you control; Special Summon 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon" from your Deck or GY, then you can banish 1 monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, until the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Change Dragon" once per turn.

cards.name: Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon - Photon Howling
cards.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Neo Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon - Photon Howling" by using 1 Rank 8 Xyz Monster you control (transfer its materials). If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can take 1 "Photon" monster from your Deck, and either Special Summon it in Defense Position or attach it to this card as material. (Quick Effect): You can detach 3 materials from this card; Tribute 1 other Xyz Monster, and if you do, negate the effects of all other face-up cards currently on the field until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Red Dragon Archfiend's Chains
cards.description: You can activate this card the turn it was Set, by revealing 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" in your Extra Deck. Activate this card by revealing any number of monsters in your hand, then target Effect Monsters your opponent controls equal to the number of Tuners revealed +1; those monsters lose 100 ATK for each card revealed, also their effects are negated. If none of those monsters are on the field, destroy this card. You can only activate 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend's Chains" per turn.

cards.name: Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul
cards.description:
2 Tuners + 1 non-Tuner
Must be either Synchro Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing 2 Tuners and 1 "Red Dragon Archfiend" from your GY. Cannot be destroyed by card effects. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand, and if you do, this card gains 2000 ATK. You can only use this effect of "Red Nova Dragon - Burning Soul" once per Duel, and only if you have Synchro Summoned "Red Dragon Archfiend".

cards.name: Rokket Barrage
cards.description: You can send 1 DARK Dragon monster from your Deck to the GY, except a Level 5 monster; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. When a Link Monster's effect is activated that targets this card on the field (Quick Effect): You can destroy this card, then Special Summon up to 1 "Rokket" monster each from your hand, Deck, GY, and/or banishment, except "Rokket Barrage". You can only use each effect of "Rokket Barrage" once per turn.

cards.name: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
cards.description:
2 DARK monsters on the field
(This card is always treated as a "Predaplant" card.)
If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 other face-up monster on the field; change its ATK to 0, negate its effects, also it becomes DARK. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 DARK Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using DARK monsters on either field, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons" once per turn.

cards.name: The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons
cards.description: If a Spellcaster monster is on the field: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon monster from your Deck, then if your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with the same name as the Summoned monster, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Dragon or Spellcaster monsters. During your Main Phase 2, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there this turn: You can banish it; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons" once per turn.

cards.name: Triple Borrel Launch
cards.description:
Activate 1 of these effects (but you can only use each effect of "Triple Borrel Launch" once per turn);
● Shuffle 1 Dragon monster from your GY into the Deck, then you can Special Summon 1 "Rokket" monster with a different name from your Deck.
● Shuffle 2 Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, then add 1 Field Spell from your GY to your hand.
● Shuffle 3 Dragon monsters from your GY into the Deck, then shuffle up to 3 monsters from your opponent's GY into the Deck.

cards.name: Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord
cards.description:
3 "Cubic" monsters
Gains 1000 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 3 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Abyss Vagrada the Abyssal Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

cards.name: Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord
cards.description:
1 "Cubic" monster + "Vijam the Cubic Seed"
Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from your hand and/or field to the GY. Gains 800 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY. (Quick Effect): You can return this card to the Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon 2 "Cubic" monsters from your GY, and if you do that, add 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Alditia Hell Blaze the Burning Cubic Lord" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate this effect, except Fusion Monsters.

cards.name: Aqua Leviathan @Marincess
cards.description: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Marincess" card. Monsters your opponent controls lose 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Aqua Leviathan @Marincess" once per turn. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Marincess" card from your Deck to your hand, except a Ritual Monster, then discard 1 card. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can return cards your opponent controls to the hand up to the number of "Marincess" Monster Cards you control.

cards.name: Cubic Bodhi
cards.description: When this card is activated: You can send 1 "Cubic" card from your Deck to the GY. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card; place 1 Cubic Counter on 1 face-up monster your opponent controls (monsters with a Cubic Counter cannot attack, also negate their effects). If a "Cubic" monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only activate 1 "Cubic Bodhi" per turn.

cards.name: Divine Anima Infinity the Creation Cubic Overlord
cards.description:
4 "Cubic" monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 1500 ATK for each "Vijam the Cubic Seed" in your GY, also unaffected by the activated effects of monsters with ATK less than this card. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle all your banished "Cubic" cards into the Deck, and if you do, destroy 1 card your opponent controls. If this face-up card in its owner's control leaves the field by an opponent's card: You can Special Summon up to 3 "Vijam the Cubic Seed" from your GY.

cards.name: Marincess Azuri
cards.description: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 WATER Cyberse monster with 1000 or less ATK from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters. If you Link Summon a "Marincess" Link Monster(s), while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; equip 1 "Marincess" monster from your GY to 1 of those Link Monsters as an Equip Spell that gives it 600 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Azuri" once per turn.

cards.name: Marincess Reef Lagoon
cards.description: When this card is activated: You can add 1 WATER Cyberse monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can shuffle up to 3 WATER monsters from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck. You can send this face-up card to the GY; Ritual Summon 1 WATER Cyberse Ritual Monster from your hand, by banishing WATER monsters from your GY whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. You can only activate 1 "Marincess Reef Lagoon" per turn.

cards.name: Marincess Truth Heart
cards.description:
2+ "Marincess" monsters
If this card is Link Summoned using a Link Monster with 0 original ATK: You can Special Summon 1 Link-3 or lower "Marincess" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart" once per turn. You can banish 1 Link Monster Card from your field or GY; destroy 1 card your opponent controls, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot banish monsters with that same Link Rating to activate this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart".

cards.name: Marincess Ulpis
cards.description: If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other "Marincess" card or WATER monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap from your Deck. You can send 1 "Marincess" Link Monster Card you control to the GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Ulpis" once per turn.

cards.name: Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel
cards.description: Once per turn, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 "Cubic" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Pritima the Infinity Cubic Vessel" once per turn, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck the turn you activate either effect, except Fusion Monsters. During your Main Phase: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 card; add up to 2 "Cubic" Spells/Traps from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Invoked Magistus Heruvim
cards.description:
1 "Magistus" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. When your opponent activates a monster effect, or their monster declares an attack, except during the turn this card was Special Summoned (Quick Effect): You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 "Magistus" or "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, except "Invoked Magistus Heruvim". You can only use each effect of "Invoked Magistus Heruvim" once per turn.

cards.name: Magistus Witchcrafter Aruru
cards.description: If this card is in your hand and a "Magistus" monster is on the field: You can Special Summon this card. You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can banish it, then target 1 "Magistus" or "Witchcrafter" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use each effect of "Magistus Witchcrafter Aruru" once per turn.

cards.name: Trinitas Magistus
cards.description:
2+ Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can equip 1 "Magistus" or Spellcaster monster from your Extra Deck to this card as an Equip Spell. You can discard 1 card; return all Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters from your opponent's field and GY to the Extra Deck. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can add 1 "Magistus" card from your GY or banishment to your hand. You can only use 1 "Trinitas Magistus" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

cards.name: Gandora-X the Blackmetal Rampaging Dragon
cards.description: If this card is added from the Deck to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned: You can pay half your LP; destroy as many other monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the highest ATK on the field among the destroyed face-up monsters they own, and if you do that, this card gains that much ATK. If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 "Final Geas" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gandora-X the Blackmetal Rampaging Dragon" once per turn.

cards.name: Time Chain
cards.description: Destroy this card during your opponent's 2nd Standby Phase after activation. Activate this card when your monster is targeted for an attack: Neither battling monster can be destroyed by that battle, also banish them after damage calculation until their controller's 2nd Standby Phase. Negate the activated effects of monsters with the same original name as monsters that are currently banished by this card's effect. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Warrior's Devotion
cards.description: Send 1 Warrior monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses ATK equal to the sent monster's ATK. If a Warrior monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Warrior's Devotion" once per turn.

cards.name: Hope for the Future
cards.description: If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster or "Elemental HERO Neos": Discard 1 card; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions a "HERO" monster as material, using monsters from your hand, Deck, or field. If you control a "Neos" Fusion Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Hope for the Future" once per turn.

cards.name: Wicked Canon
cards.description: Each time an opponent's monster declares an attack, place 1 Sinister Doctrine Counter on this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Wicked Canon" once per turn. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 DARK Fiend monster from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 Fiend monster. You can send this card with 4 or more Sinister Doctrine Counters to the GY; Special Summon 1 Fiend monster from your Deck, then you can add 1 "Super Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils
cards.description: If "Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye" or "Snake-Eyes Poplar" is in either GY, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn this way. You can only use each of the following effects of "Diabellstar, the Seeker of Sinful Spoils" once per turn. You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Doom - Rciela" from your GY; destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish 1 "Sinful Spoils of Betrayal - Silvera" from your GY; destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
